Arcod (Architectural code Orit Doron) is a Tel-Aviv-based group of architects, designers, town planners, researchers, inventors, entrepreneurs and real estate specialists.

ENTREPRENEURSHIP
Arcod Group was established in 1987 and has vast experience in the field of architecture, design, construction and real estate.
ARCHITECTURE
Arcod is practicing design of public, mixed-use, housing and private buildings as well as offices, urban renewal and conservation.
DESIGN
Besides architecture and construction, we are always looking for new opportunities to extend our design skills.
